items.mainDefect: Background legacy writes inherit request cancellation and can abort when the HTTP request completes.

secondary.defect: Legacy-write errors are recorded only in metrics and are not logged, leaving failures invisible in logs.

items.mainDefect: Create records unified-storage failures in the legacy-duration metric.

secondary.defect: Update records unified-storage failures in the legacy-duration metric.
DeleteCollection records legacy-write durations and errors in the storage-duration metric.
Successful Delete operations use the object name instead of the resource kind as a metric label.

items.mainDefect: Update passes raw objInfo to legacy storage, recomputing the update instead of mirroring the unified-storage result.

secondary.defect: Updating an object absent from legacy storage returns NotFound and never creates the missing legacy copy.
Concurrent background legacy writes can execute out of order and leave legacy storage with stale state.

items.mainDefect: Background legacy writes inherit request cancellation and can abort after the handler returns.

secondary.defect: Mode-3 unit tests use a never-canceled background context and therefore do not exercise request-cancellation failures.
Mode-3 unit tests do not await and verify the asynchronous legacy writes.
The playlist integration tests do not reliably verify that the asynchronous legacy writes complete.

items.mainDefect: Mode-3 unit tests never await or assert the legacy writes, so removing those writes would leave the tests passing.

secondary.defect: Legacy and unified-storage test backends share one mock, preventing independent verification of backend calls.

items.mainDefect: Background legacy writes inherit request cancellation and can fail as soon as the HTTP handler returns.

secondary.defect: Unit tests use a never-canceled background context and therefore miss request-cancellation failures.

items.mainDefect: Create records unified-storage failures in the legacy-duration metric.

secondary.defect: Update records unified-storage failures in the legacy-duration metric.
DeleteCollection records legacy-write durations and errors in the storage-duration metric.
Successful Delete operations use the object name instead of the resource kind as a metric label.

items.mainDefect: Update passes raw objInfo to legacy storage instead of wrapping the object committed by unified storage, allowing divergent results.

secondary.defect: The asynchronous legacy update inherits the request context and can be aborted by request cancellation.
